variants.headline: Accident at a workplace
variants.body: An accident has occurred at a workplace in {colony}. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.

variants.headline: Workplace safety becomes immediate news
variants.body: The colony has had an accident at a workplace. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.

variants.headline: An accident enters the working day
variants.body: A workplace in the colony has been the scene of an accident. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.
